meta.decryption: AES-256-CBC, OpenSSL salted format, passphrase from SavefileConverter/js/script.js
meta.names: Species and move names use the PokeRogue enums for this save's ID space. src/data/pokemon.json names are included as srcName when that file has the species. Field names $sa, $ca, and the rest are expanded from src/patch/game-data.ts.
meta.lossless: Every original field is copied onto a raw object. Decoded names are added beside those values.
meta.natureBits: Bit 1 is Hardy through bit 25 is Quirky, matching getNaturesForAttr in src/patch/game-data.ts.
meta.dexAttrBits: NON_SHINY, SHINY, MALE, FEMALE, DEFAULT_VARIANT, VARIANT_2, VARIANT_3, then form index n at bit 7+n.
